name: Sint Maarten
prevalence_note: No Sint Maarten police bulletin was located; the postal operator PSSNV and courier fraud pages are the available references for delivery-fee texts.
cross_border_note: Sint Maarten (+1-721) shares the island with French Saint-Martin (+590), so calls from both numbering plans and from the US are routine.

scams.name: Courier delivery-fee text
scams.name_en: Unexpected courier text demanding a delivery fee or card details in Sint Maarten
scams.signals_en: An unexpected text claiming a courier or the post needs a small fee or card details before delivering a parcel to Sint Maarten.
scams.legit_en: Couriers' fraud pages and PSSNV direct customers to official channels only; unsolicited payment links are not genuine.
bait_tactics: Ask whether PSSNV in Philipsburg or the courier's own desk holds the item
Say parcels are only paid for at the courier counter
